lines.zh: 觞贾客拖着驼兽往前走
lines.en: The trader leads his pack beast on.

lines.zh: 他的脚步湿得发黏
lines.en: His steps land wet and clinging.

lines.zh: 长袍下摆沾满了海草
lines.en: Seaweed clings to his hem.

lines.zh: 他沿着岸线慢慢踱步
lines.en: He paces slowly along the shoreline.

lines.zh: 驼兽跟在后面，步子沉重
lines.en: The beast plods behind him.

lines.zh: 他时不时停下来看看海
lines.en: Now and then he stops to look at the sea.

lines.zh: 他的影子拖在湿沙上
lines.en: His shadow trails on wet sand.

lines.zh: 他绕开一个水坑又回来
lines.en: He skirts a pool and returns.

lines.zh: 他走得不快，但路很长
lines.en: Not fast, but he covers ground.

lines.zh: 他的喉咙里发出水声
lines.en: A wet sound comes from his throat.

lines.zh: 他一边走一边数着货物
lines.en: He counts his goods as he walks.

lines.zh: 他回头看驼兽有没有跟上
lines.en: He glances back to check the beast.

lines.zh: 他走过的地方留下咸味
lines.en: Salt hangs in the air where he passes.

lines.zh: 他把湿透的披风裹紧了
lines.en: He pulls his soaked cloak tighter.

lines.zh: 他慢慢蹚过浅水
lines.en: He wades slowly through shallows.

lines.zh: 他停在海浪能拍到的地方
lines.en: He stops where the surf can reach him.

lines.zh: 觞贾客站着，慢慢呼吸
lines.en: The trader stands, breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 他伸手摸了摸驼兽的背
lines.en: He runs a hand along the beast's back.

lines.zh: 他抬头看天，判断风向
lines.en: He looks up to judge the wind.

lines.zh: 他的袍子滴着水
lines.en: His robe drips.

lines.zh: 他清点了一遍箱子里的货
lines.en: He counts the stock in his chest.

lines.zh: 他从怀里掏出一枚湿硬币
lines.en: He draws out a wet coin.

lines.zh: 他把硬币在指间转了两圈
lines.en: He turns the coin twice between fingers.

lines.zh: 他舔了舔嘴唇，尝到咸味
lines.en: He licks his lips and tastes salt.

lines.zh: 他蹲下来，把鞋里的水倒掉
lines.en: He crouches and pours water from his shoes.

lines.zh: 他对着海面低声说了句什么
lines.en: He murmurs something to the sea.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸节律不太像人
lines.en: His breathing rhythm is not quite human.

lines.zh: 他把货物重新码了一遍
lines.en: He restacks his goods.

lines.zh: 他拍掉箱子上的沙
lines.en: He knocks the sand off a crate.

lines.zh: 他安静地听着浪声
lines.en: He listens quietly to the waves.

lines.zh: 觞贾客抬头，看向你
lines.en: The trader raises his head toward you.

lines.zh: 他先看你的鞋，再看脸
lines.en: He looks at your shoes first, then your face.

lines.zh: 他朝你摇了摇手中的硬币
lines.en: He flashes the coin in his hand.

lines.zh: 他伸手指了指自己的箱子
lines.en: He points at his chest.

lines.zh: 他的眼神在算你带了多少
lines.en: His eyes are counting what you carry.

lines.zh: 他往前走了一步，很客气
lines.en: He steps forward, all courtesy.

lines.zh: 他的笑容有点湿
lines.en: His smile is a little wet.

lines.zh: 他侧头打量你的装备
lines.en: He tilts his head at your gear.

lines.zh: 他抬手比了个价钱
lines.en: He flashes a price with his fingers.

lines.zh: 他摇头，表示你不合他意
lines.en: He shakes his head: not what he wants.

lines.zh: 觞贾客吃痛，抱住了箱子
lines.en: Hurt, the trader clutches his chest.

lines.zh: 他踉跄着退了半步
lines.en: He staggers back half a step.

lines.zh: 他喉咙里发出湿响
lines.en: A wet rasp comes from his throat.

lines.zh: 他低头看伤口，面无表情
lines.en: He looks at the wound, expressionless.

lines.zh: 他把驼兽往身后拉
lines.en: He pulls the beast behind him.

lines.zh: 他的披风滑下来一半
lines.en: His cloak slips half off.

lines.zh: 他弯腰喘了几口气
lines.en: He bends over, catching breath.

lines.zh: 他咬着牙把箱子扶正
lines.en: He grits his teeth and rights the chest.

lines.zh: 他退到水边，脚跟进了水
lines.en: He backs to the waterline, heels in the sea.

lines.zh: 他的眼神冷了很多
lines.en: His eyes have gone much colder.

lines.zh: 觞贾客盯着你手里的东西
lines.en: The trader fixes on what you hold.

lines.zh: 他伸手，掌心朝上
lines.en: He extends an open palm.

lines.zh: 他掂了掂重量，点头
lines.en: He weighs it and nods.

lines.zh: 他把东西收进箱子深处
lines.en: He tucks it deep in the chest.

lines.zh: 他伸手要第二件
lines.en: He reaches for a second.

lines.zh: 他对食物比对钱更感兴趣
lines.en: Food interests him more than coin.

lines.zh: 他把食物生着就吞了
lines.en: He swallows the food raw.

lines.zh: 他舔了舔手指上的汁水
lines.en: He licks the juice from his fingers.

lines.zh: 他收好东西，态度更热络
lines.en: Goods stowed, his manner warms.

lines.zh: 他开始向你推销别的货
lines.en: He starts pitching his other wares.

lines.zh: 你撞上觞贾客，他滑了一下
lines.en: You bump the trader and he slips.

lines.zh: 他扶住驼兽才没摔倒
lines.en: He steadies himself on the beast.

lines.zh: 他侧身让开，行礼道歉
lines.en: He steps aside and apologises.

lines.zh: 他的袍子擦过你的手臂，很凉
lines.en: His robe brushes your arm, cold.

lines.zh: 驼兽被撞得哼了一声
lines.en: The beast grunts at the knock.

lines.zh: 他退后检查箱子有没有掉
lines.en: He checks that nothing fell.

lines.zh: 他抬手挡了一下你的路
lines.en: He puts a hand up to stop you.

lines.zh: 他在湿地上打了个趔趄
lines.en: He staggers on the wet ground.

lines.zh: 他稳住后，先看你有没有事
lines.en: Steady again, he checks on you first.

lines.zh: 他的脚边留下一个湿印
lines.en: A wet print stays where he stood.

lines.zh: 觞贾客与同伴核对账目
lines.en: The trader checks accounts with his partner.

lines.zh: 他们把货物分成两堆
lines.en: They split the goods into two piles.

lines.zh: 他替对方把箱子抬起来
lines.en: He lifts the other's chest for them.

lines.zh: 他们低声交换了几个数字
lines.en: They trade a few numbers, quietly.

lines.zh: 两人并肩坐在箱子上
lines.en: They sit together on the chest.

lines.zh: 他把一枚硬币分给对方
lines.en: He shares one coin with his partner.

lines.zh: 他们朝同一个方向看海
lines.en: They watch the sea the same way.

lines.zh: 他们的动作湿而慢，很协调
lines.en: Their wet, slow motions fit together.

lines.zh: 他把披风搭在两人之间
lines.en: He drapes the cloak across them both.

lines.zh: 浪潮上来时他们一起退
lines.en: When the tide comes, they retreat together.

lines.zh: 觞贾客弯腰拾起硬币
lines.en: The trader stoops for the coin.

lines.zh: 他把东西擦干才收起来
lines.en: He dries the item before stowing it.

lines.zh: 他眯眼看是不是真货
lines.en: He squints to check it is genuine.

lines.zh: 他用牙咬了一下，验成色
lines.en: He bites it to test the metal.

lines.zh: 他把东西码进箱子的格子里
lines.en: He slots it into the chest's compartments.

lines.zh: 他把不要的丢回给你
lines.en: What he rejects, he tosses back.

lines.zh: 他拾取时手指间拉着黏液
lines.en: Slime strings between his fingers.

lines.zh: 他把战利品举起来看光
lines.en: He lifts the prize to the light.

lines.zh: 他小心地把东西包好
lines.en: He wraps it carefully.

lines.zh: 收好后，他拍了拍箱子
lines.en: Done, he pats the chest.

lines.zh: 觞贾客的笑意消失了
lines.en: The trader's smile disappears.

lines.zh: 他把手伸进箱子底下
lines.en: He reaches under the chest.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸声变得更湿
lines.en: His breathing turns wetter.

lines.zh: 他退后一步，把驼兽挡在前面
lines.en: He backs up, putting the beast in front.

lines.zh: 他抬手，袖口滑落
lines.en: He raises a hand; the cuff slides back.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛变得没有焦点
lines.en: His eyes lose their focus.

lines.zh: 他不再装出商人的姿态
lines.en: He drops the merchant's manner.

lines.zh: 他从喉咙里挤出一串声音
lines.en: A string of sounds squeezes from his throat.

lines.zh: 他慢慢把箱子放下
lines.en: He sets the chest down slowly.

lines.zh: 你要么买，要么走
lines.en: Either you buy, or you go.

lines.zh: 觞贾客跟在你侧后
lines.en: The trader keeps at your flank.

lines.zh: 他脚步很轻，湿泥也不响
lines.en: His steps are light, even in mud.

lines.zh: 他的手一直垂在箱子边
lines.en: His hand stays by the chest.

lines.zh: 他试着靠近一点再退开
lines.en: He edges in, then away.

lines.zh: 他的视线在你腰间来回
lines.en: His eyes go back and forth to your belt.

lines.zh: 他把驼兽牵到你和你背后之间
lines.en: He walks the beast between you and your exit.

lines.zh: 他抬头嗅了嗅空气
lines.en: He lifts his head and sniffs.

lines.zh: 他低声念了个价钱，很荒唐
lines.en: He names an absurd price, quietly.

lines.zh: 他退开半步，装出无害
lines.en: He steps back, affecting harmlessness.

lines.zh: 他一直在等你放松警惕
lines.en: He is waiting for your guard to drop.

lines.zh: 觞贾客一把抓向你的腰带
lines.en: The trader claws at your belt.

lines.zh: 他的手指冷得像海草
lines.en: His fingers are cold as kelp.

lines.zh: 他把你推得倒退，扑向箱子
lines.en: He shoves you back and dives for the chest.

lines.zh: 他抬起箱子砸过来
lines.en: He swings the chest at you.

lines.zh: 他的袖口里甩出一股水
lines.en: A jet of water snaps from his cuff.

lines.zh: 他抓你手腕，指甲很深
lines.en: He grips your wrist, nails digging.

lines.zh: 他退开，抱着货就往水里跑
lines.en: He breaks away and runs for the water.

lines.zh: 他的攻击不像训练过的
lines.en: There is no training in his attacks.

lines.zh: 他咬着牙又扑了一次
lines.en: Teeth gritted, he lunges again.

lines.zh: 他撞你自己也晃了
lines.en: He hits you and staggers too.

lines.zh: 海浪退去，沙上多了个人
lines.en: The surf pulls back and leaves a man.

lines.zh: 觞贾客从浅水里走上岸
lines.en: The trader wades out of the shallows.

lines.zh: 他抖了抖湿透的披风
lines.en: He shakes out his soaked cloak.

lines.zh: 驼兽在他身后喷着鼻息
lines.en: The beast snorts behind him.

lines.zh: 他把箱子从水里拖上来
lines.en: He drags the chest out of the water.

lines.zh: 他在岸边坐下歇了一会
lines.en: He sits on the shore to rest.

lines.zh: 海草缠在他的脚踝上
lines.en: Seaweed wraps his ankle.

lines.zh: 他抬头，先看到了你
lines.en: He looks up and sees you first.

lines.zh: 他把手在袍子上擦了擦
lines.en: He wipes his hands on his robe.

lines.zh: 他站起来，摆出做生意的样子
lines.en: He stands and puts on his trade face.

lines.zh: 火焰舔上湿袍，冒起白汽
lines.en: Fire licks his wet robe and raises steam.

lines.zh: 摔在地上时箱子砸到了他
lines.en: He lands and the chest falls on him.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，他反而笑起来
lines.en: Water floods his throat, and he laughs.

lines.zh: 爆炸把箱子掀翻，货物散落
lines.en: The blast tips the chest and spills the goods.

lines.zh: 箭扎穿了他的手掌
lines.en: An arrow pins through his palm.

lines.zh: 魔法让他皮肤下的东西乱动
lines.en: Magic sets things squirming under his skin.

lines.zh: 饿了太久，他的手在抖
lines.en: Too long unfed, his hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷击让他的水汽炸开一片
lines.en: Lightning bursts the moisture off him.

lines.zh: 虚空吸住他，箱子先掉了下去
lines.en: The void takes hold; the chest drops first.
